quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #15
										  					
  

35 Questions • Passing Score 30

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that the area ahead has low clearance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic speed and movement. They show rules that drivers must follow. This sign tells you which direction traffic moves on a one-way street.

questions.question: You see an emergency vehicle stopped with its lights flashing. You must:

options.text: Slow down and change lanes if possible so you do not drive next to the emergency vehicle.
Drive to the right side of the road and stop.
Stay in your lane and keep driving at the same speed.
Speed up to pass the stopped vehicle quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and change lanes if possible so you do not drive next to the emergency vehicle.
questions.explanation: When you see an emergency vehicle, tow truck, or roadside assistance vehicle stopped with flashing lights, change lanes to give it extra space. If changing lanes is unsafe or there is only one lane in your direction, slow down below the speed limit. Always be ready to stop at an emergency scene.

questions.question: When you see a flashing red traffic light, you must:
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. Yield to all traffic and pedestrians. Only go when it is safe. At a railroad crossing, a flashing red light means a train is coming. Wait until the lights stop flashing and all warning devices turn off before crossing.

questions.question: You must signal every time you pull away from a curb.
questions.explanation: You must always use a turn signal when you pull away from a curb.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Cars turning left on green must let oncoming traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cars turning left on green must let oncoming traffic go first.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic light. It tells drivers that left-turning traffic does not have the right-of-way. You must wait for oncoming traffic to clear before turning.

questions.question: When parking uphill on a hill with a curb, you should:

options.text: Turn your front wheels sharply toward the curb.
Turn your front wheels slightly to the right.
Turn your front wheels sharply away from the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your front wheels sharply away from the curb.
questions.explanation: When parking uphill near a curb, turn your wheels sharply away from the curb. This keeps your car from rolling into traffic. On streets without a curb, turn your wheels sharply toward the edge of the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead will make a sharp turn to the right and then a sharp turn to the left.

questions.question: On a multilane road, if you are driving slower than other traffic, you must:
questions.explanation: On a multilane highway, stay in the right lane if you are driving slower than other traffic.

questions.question: You see a sign that says "Reduced speed, 35 mph." This means:

options.text: The new 35 mph speed limit starts at this sign.
The new 35 mph speed limit starts at the next speed limit sign.
You have plenty of time to slow down before the reduced speed zone.
You should reduce your speed to 35 mph only when weather is bad.

questions.correctAnswerText: The new 35 mph speed limit starts at this sign.
questions.explanation: "Reduced speed" signs tell drivers they must reduce their speed. The new speed limit shown on the sign begins at that sign.

questions.question: Does drinking coffee after alcohol affect blood alcohol level?

options.text: It cancels the effect of alcohol.
It has no effect on blood alcohol level.

questions.correctAnswerText: It has no effect on blood alcohol level.
questions.explanation: Coffee will not lower your blood alcohol level. Coffee may keep you awake, but it cannot make you sober or change your blood alcohol level.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at that location.

questions.question: Should you use low beam headlights when driving in fog?
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog. High beams reflect off the fog and shine back into your eyes, making it harder to see.

questions.question: When there is no stop line or crosswalk marking at an intersection that requires a stop, where should you stop?

options.text: You are not required to stop.
Slow down to make sure crossing traffic is clear.
Stop where you can see at least 200 feet on either side, even if you enter the intersecting roadway.
Stop where you can see approaching traffic before entering the intersecting roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop where you can see approaching traffic before entering the intersecting roadway.
questions.explanation: Stop at the point closest to the intersecting roadway where you can see traffic coming. Do not enter the roadway to get a better view.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow line on your side of the centerline mean?
questions.explanation: A solid yellow line next to your lane means you cannot pass vehicles in front of you.

questions.question: When must you turn on your headlights?

options.text: When you use your windshield wipers.

questions.explanation: Turn on headlights at night and whenever visibility is poor. Use them during bad weather and anytime you use your windshield wipers. Turn them on at sunset.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign warn you about?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn you of hazards or dangers ahead. They are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: Do you have to yield to pedestrians walking against the traffic light?
questions.explanation: You must always yield to pedestrians, even if they are crossing against the light. Pedestrians may misread signals and cross when they should not.

questions.question: What affects how alcohol impacts your body?

options.text: The amount of food in your stomach
How much time passes between drinks

questions.explanation: Your blood alcohol content depends on how much you drink, how much time passes between drinks, and your weight. Eating before or while drinking slows alcohol absorption, but it cannot stop intoxication if you drink too much.

questions.question: Regulatory signs are usually ____ and must always be obeyed.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs control traffic movement. They are usually white with black markings and drivers must always obey them.

questions.question: Which of these must you obey before the others?
questions.explanation: A police officer's directions take priority over all signs, signals, and road markings. Authorized traffic directors include police officers, fire police, flag persons at work zones, and school crossing guards.

questions.question: When driving on slippery roads, you should:

options.text: Take turns more slowly than usual.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take turns more slowly than usual.
questions.explanation: On slippery roads, it is especially dangerous to drive fast in turns and curves. Slow down more than you normally would when taking turns in bad conditions.

questions.question: You must stop at an intersection when you see a:
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop, look both ways, and proceed only when the intersection is clear.

questions.question: How can you help prevent rear-end collisions?

options.text: Check your mirrors and blind spots before stopping.
Release the gas pedal to slow down before braking.

questions.explanation: Sudden stops make it hard for drivers behind you to avoid hitting you. When stopping, release the gas pedal first to slow down. Then apply steady brake pressure to stop smoothly and activate your brake lights.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers of hazards ahead. This sign tells drivers a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: A stop sign is shaped like a(n):
questions.explanation: Only stop signs are octagonal (eight-sided). All eight-sided signs tell drivers to come to a complete stop before going.

questions.question: When driving in fog, use your high beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use your low beam headlights in fog. High beams reflect back at you and reduce visibility.

questions.question: Stop lines are solid white lines painted across traffic lanes at:
questions.explanation: Stop lines are solid white lines across traffic lanes at intersections and pedestrian crosswalks. They show exactly where drivers must stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves sharply to the right ahead.

questions.question: When is it illegal to drive below the speed limit?

options.text: When driving slowly blocks the normal flow of traffic.
When in heavy traffic in a construction zone.
Only when driving in rural areas.

questions.correctAnswerText: When driving slowly blocks the normal flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive so slowly that you block other traffic. You can receive a ticket for driving too slowly.

questions.question: What is the most common cause of traffic crashes?
questions.explanation: Most crashes happen because drivers do not see other vehicles or make unexpected moves. Talk to other drivers on the road to help prevent crashes.

questions.question: You are driving on a narrow road and meet an oncoming vehicle. You must:

options.text: Pull completely off the road and stop.
Give the oncoming vehicle at least half of the road's main travel area.
Tell the other vehicle to pull over.
Turn on your high beam headlights so the other driver sees you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the oncoming vehicle at least half of the road's main travel area.
questions.explanation: On narrow roads, you must give vehicles going the opposite direction at least half of the main travel area. Both drivers need enough space to pass safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic are about to join into one lane ahead.
